definitions.short: a pot (for boiling ); also (by resemblance of shape) a basket
definitions.full: H1731. dud דּוּד noun masculine Jer 24:2 pot, jar (Aramaic דּוּדָא perhaps compare Syriac disturb , from the idea of boiling) — absolute דּוּד 1Sam 2:14 4 t.; plural דּוּדִים 2Kin 10:7 , דְּוַדִים 2Chr 35:13 ; plural construct דּוּדָאֵי Jer 24:1 — a. pot, kettle or cooking ( בִּשֵּׁל ) 1Sam 2:14 (|| כִּיּוֺר קַלַּחַת, מָּרוּר, ), 2Chr 35:13 (verb בִּשֵּׁל , || סִירוֺת צַלָּחוֺת, ) compare Job 41:12 ; b. receptacle for carrying, all Vrss basket , 2Kin 10:7 (heads of king's sons), Jer 24:2 (twice in verse) (figs) compare דּוּדָאֵי 24:1 , as if from a II.[[ דּוּדַי ]; Psa 81:7 (clay or bricks, || סֵבֶל ).
